items.title: New Elastic EDR 0-Day Vulnerability Allows Attackers to Bypass Detection, Execute Malware, and Cause BSOD
items.description: A newly discovered zero-day vulnerability in Elastic’s Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solution allows attackers to bypass security measures, execute malicious code, and trigger a BSOD system crash, according to the Ashes Cybersecurity research.
